output = repo / 'research/p256_factor_base_parallel_20261026/environment/checkpoint-repair-review-01'
expected_original = {'review.md': 'd8c0e4f18fa7ba75d3fd1b91a7e5069c5b118b3d3b823e7f7aa17b15ea35fb2b',
                     'result.json': 'f64f83f6441a614f2f2a6cb325be648428e3708dd4e80d3ebf168db500937b0f'}
before = {name: hashlib.sha256((output / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in expected_original}
assert before == expected_original, 'Original review artifacts changed'
record = {'source_snapshot': revision, 'source_sha256': {p: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p, b in sources.items()},
          'working_files_match_committed_source': True, 'original_sha256_before': before,
          'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(),
          'bash': subprocess.check_output(['/bin/bash', '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0],
          'native_stat': subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/stat', '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0]}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='checkpoint-cache-followup-review-') as outer:
    base = Path(outer)
    for folder in ['scripts', 'tools', 'bin', 'tmp', 'empty-template']:
        (base / folder).mkdir()
    for path, source in sources.items():
        (base / path).write_bytes(source)
    for name in ['aws', 'curl']:
        path = base / 'bin' / name
        path.write_text('#!/bin/sh\necho unexpected-network-call >&2\nexit 97\n')
        path.chmod(0o755)
    clean_env = {'PATH': str(base / 'bin') + ':/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',
                 'TMPDIR': str(base / 'tmp'), 'LC_ALL': 'C',
                 'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM': '1', 'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL': '/dev/null',
                 'GIT_CONFIG_COUNT': '1', 'GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0': 'core.hooksPath',
                 'GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0': '/dev/null', 'GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR': str(base / 'empty-template'),
                 'CHECKPOINT_TOKEN_FILE': str(base / 'absent-token'),
                 'CHECKPOINT_AWS_PROFILE': 'checkpoint-test-absent-profile'}
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', str(base / 'tools/test_checkpoint_stat.py'), '-v'],
                            cwd=base, env=clean_env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    count = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests', result.stderr)
    record['suite'] = {'command_template': 'python3 -I -B <temporary committed snapshot>/tools/test_checkpoint_stat.py -v',
                       'returncode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr,
                       'tests_run': int(count.group(1)) if count else 0,
                       'passed': result.returncode == 0 and bool(count) and count.group(1) == '5'}
after = {name: hashlib.sha256((output / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in expected_original}
record['original_sha256_after'] = after
record['original_artifacts_preserved'] = before == after == expected_original
record['finished_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
assert record['original_artifacts_preserved'], 'Original review artifacts changed'
assert record['suite']['passed'], record['suite']
print(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
